pois.name: Escalier du roi d'Aragon
pois.intro: The King of Aragon's Staircase is a staircase carved into the limestone cliff off Bonifacio on the French island of Corsica. There are 189 steps and the staircase is at a 45-degree incline.

pois.name: Abri préhistorique d'Araguina-Sennola
pois.intro: Araguina-Sennola is an archaeological site in Corsica. The prehistoric shelter is located in the commune of Bonifacio.

pois.name: Bonifacio
pois.intro: Bonifacio is a commune in the southern tip of the island of Corsica, in the French department of Corse-du-Sud. Bonifacio is the setting of Guy de Maupassant's short story "A Vendetta".

pois.name: Île Lavezzu
pois.intro: The Archipelago of Lavezzi is a collection of small granite islands and reefs in the Strait of Bonifacio that separates Corsica from Sardinia in the Mediterranean Sea. They are administered from the town of Bonifacio on Corsica.

pois.name: Île Cavallo
pois.intro: Cavallo is a small island in the Mediterranean Sea located between Corsica and Sardinia. Cavallo is the southernmost inhabited territory of metropolitan France and part of the commune of Bonifacio, Corsica.

pois.name: Phare de la Madonetta
pois.intro: Le phare de la Madonetta se trouve à l'ouest de Bonifacio en Corse-du-Sud. Il balise l'entrée du goulet de Bonifacio par l'ouest face à la pointe du Timon, à l'est.

pois.name: Phare de Pertusato
pois.intro: Le phare de Pertusato domine le cap de Pertusato à 4 km au sud-est de Bonifacio en Corse-du-Sud. Il balise la côte sud de la Corse et l'entrée du port de Bonifacio.

pois.name: Pyramide de la Sémillante
pois.description: Pyramide de la Semillante : Axe - Point vu en place en 1978
pois.intro: The Sémillante was a Surveillante class 60-gun first rank frigate of the French Navy. She sank off the coast of Corsica in 1855 with a loss of 693 people.

pois.name: Tour génoise de Sant'Amanza
pois.intro: The Tower of Sant'Amanza is a ruined Genoese tower located in the commune of Bonifacio on the south east coast of the Corsica. The tower sits at a height of 125 metres on the Punta di u Capicciolu headland.

pois.name: Île Piana
pois.intro: L'île Piana, en langue corse isula Piana, est un îlot inhabité de l'archipel des Lavezzi en Corse-du-Sud. Elle fait partie de la réserve naturelle des îles Lavezzi.
